title: Social Media Intern – AI Tools & Content Creation
description_html:
We are seeking a creative and motivated Social Media Intern to join our team on a full-time, on-site basis in Gulistan-e-Johar, Karachi. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of current social media trends and be proficient in using AI tools to develop engaging content. This role requires familiarity with various social media platforms and the ability to create compelling images, videos, captions, and innovative ideas using AI-powered applications. The working hours are from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, and the stipend will be determined based on the candidate’s skills and experience.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop engaging content tailored for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other social media channels.
- Utilize AI tools to generate images, videos, captions, and creative content ideas.
- Design social media posts, reels, and short-form videos that capture audience attention.
- Support content planning, scheduling, and timely posting across platforms.
- Conduct research on social media trends, relevant hashtags, competitors, and audience preferences.
- Contribute to enhancing engagement, expanding reach, and increasing overall brand visibility.
- Stay informed about the latest AI tools and evolving social media trends to keep content fresh and relevant.

Required Qualifications
- Basic knowledge of social media platforms and content creation processes.
- Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Canva AI, and AI-powered video generation software.
- Fundamental video editing skills using CapCut or similar editing tools.
- Strong creativity, eagerness to learn, and keen attention to detail.
- Ability to track trends and consistently generate innovative content ideas.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
Candidates who can demonstrate practical experience in AI-driven content creation will be given preference. The monthly stipend ranges from Rs20,000 to Rs40,000, depending on skills and experience. This position requires working in person at the Karachi office, providing an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in social media marketing and AI content generation within a dynamic environment.

title: AI-Driven Digital Marketing & Content Intern
description_html:
We are seeking a creative and tech-savvy Digital Marketing & Content Intern to join our team and contribute to expanding our digital presence across various social media platforms. This internship is perfect for someone passionate about digital marketing, content creation, AI tools, SEO, and social media growth. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about experimenting with new AI technologies to craft engaging content, enhance online visibility, and support B2B lead generation efforts within the healthcare technology and software solutions sector.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop engaging social media posts, including carousels, reels, short videos, and promotional content.
- Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Canva AI for content ideation, research, writing, editing, and visual design.
- Write SEO-friendly blogs and website content in English; proficiency in Arabic content creation is a plus.
- Produce short-form video content focused on healthcare software, SaaS products, marketing campaigns, and brand awareness.
- Assist in managing social media channels including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
- Conduct research on trending topics, content formats, hooks, competitor activities, and audience interests to inform content strategy.
- Support LinkedIn outreach, audience research, and B2B lead-generation initiatives.
- Keep up-to-date with emerging AI tools, digital marketing trends, and best practices in social media management.

Required Qualifications:
- Strong communication and writing skills in English.
- Genuine interest in AI-driven digital marketing and content creation.
- Basic understanding of social media platforms and core digital marketing principles.
- Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Canva, or similar technologies.
- Foundational content writing and research abilities.
- Interest in SEO, social media growth strategies, video editing, and content marketing.
- Creative mindset, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn and adapt.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Experience or skills in Arabic content creation will be advantageous.
- Opportunity to work in person, gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI tools and digital marketing techniques.
- Exposure to B2B marketing within the healthcare technology and software industry.
- Collaborative team environment fostering creativity and professional growth.

Candidates will be asked to respond to application questions including: which AI tools they currently use for content creation, design, or video editing; examples of social media posts, reels, blogs, or other digital content they have created; self-assessment of their English proficiency; and their expected stipend.

This internship offers a valuable opportunity to develop practical skills in digital marketing and content creation while working closely with a dynamic team focused on innovation and growth in the healthcare technology space. The position requires in-person attendance to facilitate collaboration and hands-on learning.

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Intern (AI, GEO & ASO)
description_html:
ARSWIFT Private Limited is a dynamic digital agency specializing in website development, mobile applications, AI automation, and digital marketing campaigns for clients across the Gulf, Europe, and North America. We are seeking a motivated and curious SEO & Digital Marketing Intern eager to learn about modern search strategies and growth opportunities in the AI-driven landscape. This internship offers hands-on experience, working closely with our marketing and development teams on live client projects, with mentorship provided from day one.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct keyword research, perform on-page SEO, and carry out technical SEO audits for client websites.
- Optimize content for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to improve visibility in AI-generated answers from platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- Manage App Store Optimization (ASO) by refining keywords, titles, descriptions, screenshots, and ratings for iOS and Android applications.
- Utilize AI tools including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and similar technologies for content research, drafting, and campaign ideation.
- Support social media initiatives, Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, email marketing efforts, and maintain content calendars.
- Monitor performance metrics using Google Analytics, Search Console, and app store consoles, and prepare straightforward performance reports.

Required Qualifications
- Fresh graduate or final-year student pursuing Marketing, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
- Basic understanding of SEO principles, digital marketing fundamentals, and search engine ranking mechanisms.
- Awareness of emerging AI tools, GEO, and ASO for mobile applications; familiarity with all three is highly advantageous.
- Strong written English skills and a proactive attitude toward learning and accepting feedback.
- No prior professional experience required.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Familiarity with tools such as Canva, WordPress, Google Analytics, or Search Console is a plus.
- Receive structured mentorship from experienced marketers and developers to enhance your skills.
- Gain practical experience by working on real client projects, enriching your professional portfolio.
- Earn an internship certificate and a recommendation letter upon successful completion of the program.
- Opportunity to transition into a full-time position based on performance and fit within the team.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply via LinkedIn by submitting their CV. If you have any SEO, ASO, or content work that you are proud of, please include a link to showcase your skills. This internship is an excellent opportunity to develop expertise in digital marketing within a forward-thinking agency embracing AI innovations.

title: Digital Support Intern
description_html:
Company Description We are a global technology company specialising in AI solutions, data engineering, custom software development, and digital marketing. We help startups, SMEs, and enterprises build intelligent systems that drive growth and digital transformation. While we operate globally, we have a strong strategic focus on empowering businesses in the Middle East markets.

Role Description The Digital Support Intern is a full-time, on-site role based in Johar Town. This role supports digital initiatives by assisting with online campaign execution, basic content updates, and coordination of digital marketing activities. The intern will help analyze digital performance data, prepare reports, and contribute to ongoing digital strategy discussions.

Daily responsibilities may include supporting project documentation, maintaining task trackers, communicating with internal teams, and ensuring timely follow-up on assigned activities. The intern will also collaborate with cross-functional colleagues to learn and apply best practices in digital operations and client support.

Qualifications
  • Effective communication skills for clear written and verbal communication with team members.
  • Understanding of Digital Strategy and Digital Marketing concepts to assist in planning and executing online initiatives.
  • Basic Project Management skills to help organize tasks, manage timelines, and support coordination across teams.
  • Proficiency with common productivity tools.
  • Interest in technology, AI, and digital transformation, with a willingness to learn and adapt quickly.
  • Ability to work on-site in Johar Town and collaborate in a diverse, inclusive team environment.

title: Social media and visual communication intern
description_html:
We are seeking a curious and visually sharp individual with a passion for social media and creative tools. The ideal candidate is organized, quick to turn direction into polished content, and eager to engage with the full content creation process—from ideation to publishing. This role blends content creation, social media management, and design execution, offering hands-on experience with real brands and marketing challenges.

Key Responsibilities
- Research social media trends, formats, memes, hooks, competitors, and content opportunities to inform strategy.
- Monitor brand and creator activity across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others.
- Assist in building weekly and monthly content calendars to maintain a consistent publishing schedule.
- Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to brainstorm and develop content ideas.
- Write and refine captions, hooks, headlines, and short-form social media copy.
- Design social media posts, carousels, stories, ad creatives, and other visual assets.
- Translate creative briefs, moodboards, references, and brand guidelines into finished designs.
- Adapt content into various formats and sizes tailored to different social media platforms.
- Support scheduling, uploading, and publishing content across social channels.
- Help maintain organized content pipelines and assist with basic social media management tasks.
- Source relevant photography, video clips, illustrations, memes, icons, and other creative assets.
- Make revisions based on creative and strategic feedback to ensure quality and alignment.
- Maintain visual and messaging consistency across all content.
- Utilize AI and modern creative tools to research, ideate, write, and execute content efficiently.
- Occasionally support website, presentation, campaign, and broader marketing design needs.

Required Qualifications
- Strong interest in social media, digital marketing, brands, advertising, and internet culture.
- Good visual sensibility with a basic understanding of layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.
- Proficiency in Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or similar design tools.
- Ability to research trends and identify engaging content opportunities.
- Solid writing skills, especially for captions, hooks, and short-form content.
- Ability to follow creative direction and references closely.
- Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
- Capability to manage multiple content pieces at different stages simultaneously.
- Openness to receiving feedback and making necessary revisions.
- Willingness to experiment with new platforms, formats, and AI tools.

Perfect grammar, advanced illustration skills, or extensive agency experience are not required. The ability to understand ideas and turn them into publishable content is what matters most.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Familiarity with video editing tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and experience with short-form video content like TikTok or Instagram Reels is a plus.
- Experience with Meta Business Suite and social media publishing/scheduling tools is advantageous.
- Exposure to Google Docs, Sheets, or similar tools for content planning is helpful.

This internship is ideal for individuals who spend significant time on social media, naturally notice trends and campaigns, and enjoy both the conceptual and hands-on aspects of content creation. You should be comfortable switching between design tools, AI platforms, spreadsheets, and social media channels. A desire to understand why content works, not just how it looks, will help you thrive.

What You’ll Learn
You will gain practical experience in social media strategy, content research, trend spotting, content calendar development, copywriting, brand voice, social media design, creative strategy, performance advertising creatives, content production workflows, publishing, basic content performance analysis, brand identity systems, working from creative briefs, design critique, iteration, and AI-assisted creative workflows. Most importantly, you will understand how strategy, copy, design, distribution, and business objectives integrate to create effective social media content.

Portfolio / Work Samples
A formal degree is not required. Candidates are encouraged to showcase social media pages they have contributed to, Canva or Figma designs, university or personal projects, freelance work, Behance portfolios, edited reels or videos, content calendars, or even personal social accounts that demonstrate strong content instincts. We value practical skills and creativity over formal titles.
